explanations.title: Validates and bounds model calls
explanations.summary: Calls now reject unknown providers and invalid requests before reaching an adapter. Provider calls get a timeout, and only errors marked temporary are retried with increasing delays.

explanations.title: Records usage and call outcomes
explanations.summary: Each call is recorded with duration, attempts, usage, and estimated cost. Recording uses a context that remains active even if the original request is canceled; cached responses have zero recorded cost.

explanations.title: Adds an optional prompt cache
explanations.summary: Responses are cached by a hash of the provider, model, system text, prompt, token limit, and temperature. Cache read or write failures do not block the provider call; cache hits are marked as cached.

explanations.title: Supports three model providers
explanations.summary: Adds adapters for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Bedrock. OpenAI and Anthropic send provider-specific HTTP requests and return response text and token usage; Bedrock delegates invocation to an injected adapter.

explanations.title: OpenAI calls ignore temperature
explanations.summary: The OpenAI adapter does not include the request temperature in its payload, so OpenAI calls ignore that setting even though the gateway validates it and the Anthropic adapter forwards it.

explanations.title: Classifies provider HTTP failures
explanations.summary: HTTP failures are reduced to provider name and status code; only rate limits and server errors are marked retryable by the gateway. Response decoding is limited to 8 MiB.
